turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Hale. I have a client call at 4:40, so we have about twenty minutes. Owen found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class, and nobody called me first, so start with who decided that and when.
I don't think this is productive.
Productive. You entered a zero without calling me, and you asked for this meeting, so tell me who decided and on what basis. If you can't, I'm going to the principal's office next.
I'm going to go. I have a class in ten minutes.
Then go, and I'll be in the principal's office before your class starts. The zero comes off, and I want it in writing that nothing is on his record. Last chance to tell me who decided, Hale.
Email the principal if you want. I'm done here.

I'm not emailing anyone, I'm walking down the hall, and I'm bringing your own procedure 4.2 with me. You were supposed to call me before that mark went in. I'm writing down that you walked out of a meeting you asked for, Hale.
